title: The 8 Best Random Orbital Sander 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for random orbital sander 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at random orbital sander 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Bosch ROS20VSC 5 In. Palm Random Orbit Sander/Polisher
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-inch pad, Variable speed 7,500-12,000 OPM, Microfilter dust canister.
strengths: Variable speed allows slowing down for fine grits and delicate surfaces
Bosch microfilter canister captures fine sanding dust effectively
Low vibration design reduces hand fatigue during long sanding sessions
The most commonly recommended corded random orbital sander by furniture makers
limitations: Canister capacity is limited -- frequent emptying during heavy sanding
Not connected to shop vac without adaptor
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Festool 575039 ETS EC 150/3 EQ Random Orbit Sander
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-inch pad, Brushless EC motor, Systainer compatible.
strengths: EC brushless motor delivers more power with less heat and longer life than brushed motors
6-inch pad covers more surface area per pass than 5-inch sanders
Festool dust collection is the most effective of anysander -- nearly zero airborne dust
Systainer storage for organization and transport in a professional cabinet shop
limitations: Requires Festool CT dust extractor for best dust collection

products.name: DEWALT DCW210B 20V MAX Orbital Sander, Tool Only
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V Max battery, 5-inch pad, Variable speed.
strengths: Cordless operation -- no cord to manage on furniture or on-site work
20V Max battery platform compatible with the DeWalt tool ecosystem
Variable speed for delicate and aggressive sanding
The correct choice for woodworkers who want cord-free sanding freedom
limitations: Battery life -- have a second battery for longer sanding sessions

products.name: Makita BO5041K 5-Inch Random Orbit Sander
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-inch pad, Variable speed, 8-hole dustless.
strengths: Makita precision and quality control -- one of the smoothest running sanders
8-hole pad compatible with 8-hole dustless sanding discs
Cushioned pad conforms slightly to irregular surfaces
The correct sander for woodworkers in the Makita tool ecosystem
limitations: Dust canister is smaller than Bosch
Slightly higher price than Bosch for similar performance

products.name: PORTER-CABLE Random Orbit Sander, 5-Inch (382)
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-inch pad, 2 amps, Dust-sealed switch.
strengths: The most affordable functional random orbital sander
Dust-sealed switch -- the switch is the most failure-prone part of budget sanders
Simple operation -- no variable speed to adjust
The correct entry sander for woodworkers who need to sand without spending on a premium tool
limitations: No variable speed -- runs at one speed only
Vibration is higher than premium models
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Mirka DEROS 650X CV 6-Inch Random Orbital Sander
products.blurb: Key specs: Electric brushless, Ultra-low vibration, Dust extraction ready.
strengths: Mirka DEROS is the reference for vibration levels -- the lowest vibration random orbital sander
Finnish manufacturing -- Mirka abrasives and sanders are the professional automotive refinishing standard
Brushless motor for efficiency and longevity
Ultra-low vibration is critical for operators who sand 4+ hours per day

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Orbital Sander, 5 Inch, 2.0 Amp (BDERO100)
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-inch pad, Dust collector, Single speed.
strengths: The lightest random orbital sander-- easiest to control for new users
Dust collector reduces airborne dust for the most affordable sander
Hook and loop pad accepts standard 5-inch discs
The correct first sander for someone who has never used a random orbital sander
limitations: Lower quality construction -- suitable for light occasional use

products.name: WEN 20405 20V Max Cordless Brushless 5-Inch Random Orbit Sander
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V Max brushless, 3-speed dial (6,000/8,500/11,000 OPM), 5-inch pad.
strengths: Brushless motor delivers strong performance while extending runtime versus brushed cordless sanders
3-speed dial for delicate and aggressive sanding
Ships complete with battery and charger, unlike most bare-tool cordless sanders
The correct cordless sander for woodworkers who don't already own a battery-tool ecosystem
limitations: 20V Max platform is less common in professional shops than Milwaukee or DeWalt
Single battery included -- a second is useful for longer sessions
